$comment: The schemas of the services' own areas that the suites read: their configuration documents and health answers, and Archivist's anchored-text entry. Each is a schema at the top of an area of specs/src, found there by its name; the gateway's document lists none of them. harness/services-document.ts writes harness/generated/services.openapi.json from this list: openapi-typescript types it (harness/generated/services-types.ts), and the harness's servicesSpec() validates against it.
